$comment: An OVERRIDE file, not a theme: `extends` names the base whose complete token set this file inherits, and ONLY the keys that DIFFER live here. Anything absent is not a gap — it is the shesha value, resolved in memory by shesha-form-edit/scripts/compile/resolve-theme.mjs and validated as a COMPLETE theme against shesha-design-system/schemas/theme.schema.json before a single component is emitted. Duplicating a base value here is a defect: it re-introduces the drift inheritance exists to delete.
$source: Shesha default (shesha.tokens.json) with a bolder interactive voice — same structural system (identical key names, spacing scale and radius scale), stronger brand saturation and a brand-tinted page-header band.
$description: For "modern / professional, no specific brand" briefs. Electric Cobalt (#0047FF) is a fully-saturated take on the Shesha primary: same hue family, more presence on buttons, links, focus rings and active states. The page-header band is BRAND-TINTED (#E0E9FF) instead of white, so page anatomy reads at a glance without touching the neutral card/canvas system. Spacing, radius and the 400/600 weight binary are identical to the default — this is a colour-voice variant, not a different layout system.

$antdTheme.$use: The resolved Ant Design 6.x ConfigProvider theme for the shesha-bold brand. Apply this OBJECT verbatim at the app level (Configuration Studio → Settings → Default UI → Frontend → Theme settings, or the settings API with the `sha-frontend-application: default-app` header) — see references/app-theme.md. This is the 'set once' layer; per-component v7 style blocks handle what it can't express.
